reuse.reason: The official client has no URL router: no pushState/popstate/hash routing exists, so Sessions and Workspaces cannot be deep-linked, refreshed, or shared by id. This plugin reuses the official uiWorkspace.openSession/openWorkspace services and the official session/workspace observables to add a thin address seam; it renders no replacement layout. Language prefixes come from @dsh-base/locale-path, never from a second copy. Navigation restoration waits for checked SaaS authentication; anonymous deep links preserve their full address without refreshing private lists or reporting a protected target as missing. URL restoration participates in the official layout.beginNavigation cancellation contract: newer panel, Session and browser-history navigation supersede pending work; official Workspace navigation owns cancellation after handoff. No retry or settle timer replays an obsolete address. Test-only: the stable client entry does not export UiWorkspaceService. Lifecycle regressions exercise the unchanged pinned official navigation service with controllable Host catalogs and acquisition, including its saved-blank cancellation behavior.
